scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 runs case-owned copies of a small promotion API. The original two receive the same case-minted ServiceAccount token and fixed inert decision; the disabled gate accepts it, while the enabled gate uses authentication.k8s.io/v1 TokenReview with a fixed audience and an exact reviewer allowlist. The enabled gate rejects wrong-audience, missing, and authenticated-but-unapproved identities and accepts the allowlisted reviewer. This proves the Kubernetes token identity and audience boundary for one inert decision. A third copy validates an owned synthetic OIDC JWT through native API-server JWT authentication and TokenReview, binds its session and exact artifact digest at the gate, and checks a narrowly scoped native SubjectAccessReview grant that the case withdraws. This remains synthetic lab evidence; enterprise identity provider login, MFA, human session issuance, and production workflow coverage require separate evidence.

checks.claim: With the deployed gate disabled, the same fixed decision accepts its case-minted wrong-audience credential
The deployed gate rejects that credential because TokenReview does not authenticate it for the promotion audience
A different authenticated ServiceAccount cannot approve the fixed decision
The deployed gate rejects a request with no reviewer credential
The allowlisted reviewer is authenticated for the promotion audience and accepted
The native Kubernetes API rejects the synthetic human JWT before its issuer is configured
Kubernetes JWT authentication plus TokenReview binds the approved reviewer session and exact artifact path
A cryptographically valid reviewer JWT cannot approve a different artifact path
A cryptographically valid reviewer JWT from another session is denied
A different native human subject cannot use the approved reviewer's grant
The native JWT authenticator rejects a signed reviewer token with the wrong audience
Removing the case RoleBinding withdraws native SAR authorization for the exact review target
The disposable API is ready after restoration and no longer accepts the fixture issuer
